description: This file defines the CRDevTools class which manages preferences for Chromium DevTools integration, including reading, writing, and intercepting DevTools embedder methods. It interacts with the filesystem and a CRSession object.

classes.name: CRDevTools
classes.description: A class that intercepts preferences-related DevTools embedder methods and stores preferences as a JSON file.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes CRDevTools with the preferences file path.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up event listeners on a CRSession to handle DevTools preferences and messaging.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Serializes and writes preferences to the file, ensuring serialized access.
